definitions.explanation: The eleventh month of the year. Late autumn with peak foliage in many areas and the Shichi-Go-San festival for children.

notes:
{十一月|じゅういちがつ} is November, the eleventh month of the year.

FORMATION:
⟦{十一|じゅういち}→十一：00949_juuichi⟧ (eleven) + ⟦{月|がつ}→月：noentry⟧ (month)

SEASON:
Late autumn in Japan. ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧ (autumn foliage) reaches its peak in many areas.

EVENTS:
- ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧ (November 15): festival celebrating children aged 3, 5, and 7. Families visit shrines.
- ⟦{勤労感謝|きんろうかんしゃ}→勤労感謝：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (November 23): Labor Thanksgiving Day (national holiday)
